question: Determine the integrating factor (I.F.) of the linear differential equation $\frac{dy}{dx} - 2x y = x$.
explanation:
Rewrite in standard form: $\frac{dy}{dx} + P(x)y = Q(x)$ where $P(x) = -2x$

Integrating factor, $I.F. = e^{\int -2x dx} = e^{-x^2}$

Required I.F. is $e^{-x^2}$.
